The existing 9,573 rows are left exactly as they are. They are another campaign's history and rewriting them would be correcting the artifact instead of the producer.
question: Where will an Odyssey campaign's hours go?

root_cause.the_actual_defect: tools/odyssey_costmodel.py record() stamped _evidence MEASURED regardless, so a start marker asserted a measurement of zero seconds. And nothing anywhere records a COMPLETION event carrying a duration, so no wall can be derived by pairing.
root_cause.why: All seven call sites record a LAUNCH marker, where no duration exists yet, and take the 0.0 default. Zero is the RIGHT value for a start marker.
